dod: npx tsc -b && npx vitest run tests/storageKeysAliveGuard.test.ts --reporter=dot

invariant.statement: Claves declaradas en STORAGE_KEYS sin ninguna referencia en el codigo: 11 -> 0.

metric.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const cfg=fs.readFileSync('src/core/config/appConfig.ts','utf8');const body=cfg.split('export const STORAGE_KEYS')[1].split('} as const')[0];const declared=[...body.matchAll(/^\\s*([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+)\\s*:\\s*.\\S/gm)].map(m=>m[1]);const files=[];const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()){if(['node_modules','.git','dist'].includes(e.name))continue;walk(p);}else if(/[.](ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs)$/.test(e.name))files.push(p);}};walk('src');walk('tests');const used=new Set();for(const f of files){const t=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');for(const m of t.matchAll(/STORAGE_KEYS[.]([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)/g))used.add(m[1]);}console.log(declared.filter(k=>!used.has(k)).length)"
